name: Reputation
llm_description: Reputation is Taylor Swift's sixth studio album, a darker, edgier electro-pop record that addressed the media backlash and public feuds of 2016, exploring themes of reputation, revenge, and finding love amid chaos.
llm_emotion_analysis: Defiant and dramatic; bold, aggressive posturing over darker production, softened by vulnerable moments of romantic devotion.
llm_overall_public_reception: Mixed to positive; a commercial smash selling over a million first-week copies, though critics were divided over the aggressive tone, with later reappraisal of its softer second half.
